name: browser-use
headline: Optimize SEO/GEO with Claude SEO skill
short_description: Production-ready Claude skill for comprehensive SEO/GEO optimization. Analyzes content for traditional search engines + AI platforms (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini). Includes entity extraction, schema generation, and multi-format audit reports.
author: 199-biotechnologies

sections.overview:
This skill audits and optimizes content for visibility across traditional search engines (Google, Bing), AI platforms (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini), answer engines, voice assistants, and social media. It extracts metadata, generates JSON-LD schema markup, identifies semantic keyword clusters, and applies platform-specific optimizations automatically. The toolkit includes entity extraction, freshness monitoring, citation enhancement, and instant indexing via IndexNow to accelerate content discovery. It supports HTML, Markdown, and React/JSX files, with multi-format audit reports (JSON, Markdown, HTML) to guide implementation.
Audit existing content and generate SEO/GEO optimization recommendations across platforms
Automatically apply platform-specific optimizations for ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews
Generate and validate schema markup (FAQ, Article) with E-E-A-T signals for AI citation
Submit fresh content for instant indexing via IndexNow to reach AI platforms in minutes
